name: TS Network CRM
summary: A multi-role CRM for coordinating internet repeater and security camera visits, customer calls, appointments, payments, inventory, and field work.
functions: Centralizes customers, calls, technical visits, schedules, payments, inventory, tasks, and PDF reports, with dedicated access for administrators, agents, moderators, and technicians.
problem: Information was scattered across spreadsheets, cloud files, and WhatsApp messages, making it difficult to coordinate customers, products, visits, and working time.
solution: I developed a centralized, role-based web system where each team can access the information it needs in real time to support customers and manage operations.

demo.title: Private system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the platform belongs to the company and contains sensitive customer and operational data.
